sections.heading: How to Play Outlaw
sections.body:
[h2 type=bar toc="How to Play Outlaw"][color=c4]Outlaw Rogue Rotation in Midnight Season 2[/color][/h2]

Outlaw Rogue is a fairly simple spec once you get past the high APM requirements. The 3 key factors of the spec. Using your cooldowns on cooldown, making sure to efficiently spend combo points without overcapping, and maintaining high APM and not missing a potential global. The core concepts to keep in mind in single target are these, in order of importance:

[wrapper width=1100px][box border=true]
[center][table style=grid]
[tr][td]
	[table]
	[tr]
	[td width=5%][icon name=spell_shadow_shadowworddominate size=medium type=round color=c4 inline=true][/icon][/td]
	[td][b][color=rogue]Cooldowns On Cooldown:[/color][/b] Oultaw Rogue has a handful of minor cooldowns that you want to make sure to use on cooldown. These primary cooldowns are [spell=271877], [spell=13750], and [spell=315341].[/td]
	[/tr]
	[/table]
[hr]
	[table]
	[tr]
	[td width=5%][icon name=ability_rogue_pistolshot size=medium type=round color=c4 inline=true][/icon][/td]
	[td][b][color=rogue]Reacting to Procs While Keeping Pace:[/color][/b] Outlaw Rogue is a spec you need to maintain a high rate of actions per minute (APM), while also reacting to the 2 primary procs the spec has. [spell=195627] being an enhanced generator, and [spell=381828] causing you to generate combo points after you cast [spell=315341]. [/td]
	[/tr]
	[/table]
[hr]
	[table]
	[tr][td width=5%][icon name=archaeology_5_0_changkiboard size=medium type=round color=c4 inline=true][/icon][/td]
	[td][b][color=rogue]Managing Resources:[/color][/b] Combo Points are the main resource we play with; avoid overcapping them as much as possible.[/td]
	[/tr]
	[/table]
[/td][/tr][/table]
[/center]
[/box][/wrapper]
[pad]
[center][cta-button guide=32900 icon=ability_rogue_waylay]Outlaw Rogue Starter Guide[/cta-button][/center]

sections.heading: Major Cooldowns
sections.body:
[h2 toc="Major Cooldowns" type=bar][color=c4][icon name=ability_rogue_restlessblades type=round size=medium inline=true color=c4][/icon] Outlaw Rogue Major Cooldowns[/color][/h2]
Unlike a majority of specs in WoW, Outlaw Rogue doesn't really have a "major cooldown" in the traditional sense, instead trading that off for a mediocre cooldown that has an above-average uptime. Below, I will highlight some of the more important cooldowns we have either way.

[pad]
[tabs name="cds" uniform=true iconborders=true]

[tab name="Adrenaline Rush" icon=Spell_shadow_shadowworddominate]
	[h3 type=bar toc=false][color=c4] Adrenaline Rush [/color][/h3]
	While this buff is active, we gain a dramatic increase to our energy regen and a lowered GCD that scales with haste. It can be decreased to 0.8 seconds from the base 1 second with 25% haste. We only need 22% raw due to [spell=193539]. With [spell=79096] being as strong as it is, good play directly links to more uptime of [spell=13750]. 
[/tab]
[tab name="Roll the Bones" icon=ability_rogue_rollthebones]
	[h3 type=bar toc=false][color=c4] Roll the Bones [/color][/h3]
	How it works is that whenever you press the button, you are given a random stage of the 4 possible outcomes. Each stage gives you a bonus alongside all the previous stages. 

	Stage 1 is increased [spell=279876] chance.
	Stage 2 is [spell=193315] generates an additional combo point.
	Stage 3 is increased [spell=79096] effectiveness.
	Stage 4 is increased Critical Strike chance.
[/tab]
[tab name="Keep it Rolling" icon=ability_rogue_keepitrolling]
	[h3 type=bar toc=false][color=c4] Keep it Rolling [/color][/h3]
	Despite this spell's massive 6-minute cooldown, its effective in-combat cooldown is only around 1:15 seconds thanks to [spell=79096]. To avoid wasting its cooldown, you will want to use this any time [spell=315508] is on stage 3 or higher.
[/tab]
[tab name="Preparation" icon=ability_rogue_preparation]
	[h3 type=bar toc=false][color=c4] Preparation [/color][/h3]
	This ability, in most instances, can be fairly autopilot, just use it when the conditions are met. However, because this [i]doesn't[/i] work with [spell=79096], we can be a bit more nuanced in its usage on certain encounters. If a fight is, for example, only going to last 3 minutes, you always get 1 cast of [spell=1277933]. This means we can use the spell at the best of an encounter, which could be a burn phase, or even an add phase to maximize AoE damage. Keep in mind that you don't want to lose casts by holding it for too long!
[/tab]

[/tabs]


[pad]

[pad]

Our Outlaw Rogue guides are always updated with the latest information from in-game experience, simulations, and logs. Make sure to check our changelog for this page by clicking on [b]View Changelog[/b] in the Quick Facts column or on the book icon at the top of the page. If you are interested in more in-depth Outlaw Rogue guides for [b]Midnight Season 2[/b], make sure to browse the [i]Navigation Bar[/i] at the top of the page, along with our list of [b]Related Guides[/b] just beneath the [i]Table of Contents[/i].







[tooltip name=NotesHighlight][color=q]Notes will appear here[/color][/tooltip]
[tooltip name=rtb][color=q]Each stage offers all the bonuses from the previous stage, so it's important to be aggressive for good outcomes.[/color][/tooltip]
[tooltip name=ks][color=q]A small optimization is that if both Between the Eyes, and Killing Spree are off cooldown at the same time, Supercharge the Between the Eyes first to get the damage bonus added to Killing Spree as well. It's never worth holding Between the Eyes for this lineup, but when it happens you can take advantage of it.[/color][/tooltip]
